food-kat-kat-banann.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual food card for a travel website. Create one polished culinary watercolor illustration, landscape 3:2, no text. Subject: Seychellois kat kat bannann, a comforting savory coarse mash of cooked unripe green bananas and flaked fish in thick coconut milk. A shallow rustic bowl holds ivory roughly mashed starchy banana with a few small soft chunks, tender white fish flakes folded throughout and a gently creamy pale sauce with a little translucent onion and a few green herb flecks. The banana has been peeled and is starchy, not ripe sweet yellow banana; the fish is cooked and boneless. This is not a curry-red soup, banana dessert, or raw fish plate. Three-quarter overhead composition, soft tropical daylight, warm ceramic bowl, sage linen and uncluttered cream paper background. Detailed, appetizing hand-painted watercolor, visibly an illustration. Single dish, no words, logos, watermark, collage, people, or buildings.
